statement: A missile or drone attack on Saudi Arabian territory claimed by or attributed to the Houthis, counting interceptions, occurs between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-07.
resolution: TRUE if at least two of AP, Reuters and AFP report a missile or drone attack on Saudi territory, claimed by or attributed to the Houthis and including interceptions, occurring between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-07.
failure_condition: No missile or drone attack on Saudi territory claimed by or attributed to the Houthis, including an intercepted one, took place between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-07.

statement: The US President or the Government of Iran publicly announces a ceasefire, truce or cessation of hostilities between the United States and Iran between 2026-09-17 and 2026-11-02.
resolution: TRUE if AP and Reuters both report that the US President or the Government of Iran announced a ceasefire, truce or cessation of US-Iran hostilities between 2026-09-17 and 2026-11-02; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Neither the US President nor the Government of Iran announced a ceasefire, truce or cessation of US-Iran hostilities between 2026-09-17 and 2026-11-02.

statement: Russia and Ukraine complete at least one exchange of prisoners of war, announced by both governments, between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-16.
resolution: TRUE if both the Russian Defence Ministry and the Ukrainian government (the President or the POW Coordination Headquarters) announce a completed prisoner-of-war exchange that took place between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-16.
failure_condition: No exchange of prisoners of war between Russia and Ukraine was completed between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-16.

statement: WTI crude oil, as the EIA Cushing spot price in FRED series DCOILWTICO, closes below 90.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 101.87 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DCOILWTICO shows a daily value below 90.00 for any date between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-30; otherwise FALSE. Reference: 101.87 WTI on the packet date, per the packet market snapshot.
failure_condition: The WTI Cushing spot price closed at or above 90.00 dollars per barrel on every trading day from 2026-09-17 through 2026-10-30.

statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range at its scheduled meeting of 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28.
resolution: TRUE if FRED DFEDTARU for 2026-10-29 exceeds its 2026-10-27 value, i.e. a hike at the 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28 meeting. Reference: relative to the 2026-10-27 upper bound; packet holds no funds-rate level.
failure_condition: The FOMC left the federal funds target range unchanged or lowered it at its 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28 meeting.

statement: The S&P 500 closes at or below 7046.19, a 7.5 percent decline from the packet reference, on at least one trading day between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 7617.50 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series SP500 shows a daily close at or below 7046.19 for any date between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-30; otherwise FALSE. Reference: 7617.50 on the packet date.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 closed above 7046.19 on every trading day from 2026-09-17 through 2026-10-30.

statement: CISA adds the exploited Acronis backup plugin for cPanel vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog carries an entry with vendorProject Acronis whose product or vulnerabilityName references cPanel and whose dateAdded falls between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-30; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: CISA added no Acronis cPanel-related vulnerability to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-30.

statement: CISA adds a WSO2 vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog carries an entry with vendorProject WSO2 whose dateAdded falls between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-30; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: CISA added no WSO2 vulnerability to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-30.

statement: Democrats win control of the US Senate in the 2026-11-03 midterm elections, holding at least 51 seats with caucusing independents in the 120th Congress.
resolution: TRUE if the senate.gov party division for the 120th Congress, read on 2027-01-08 after the 2026-11-03 election, shows Democrats plus independents caucusing with them at 51 or more seats; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Democrats plus independents caucusing with them hold 50 or fewer seats in the 120th Congress Senate as of 2027-01-08.

statement: Friedrich Merz formally resigns as German Federal Chancellor, or the Bundestag elects a different Chancellor, between 2026-09-17 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if Bundestag or Federal Government records show Merz formally submitted his resignation as Chancellor, or the Bundestag elected another person Chancellor, between 2026-09-17 and 2026-12-31; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Merz neither formally resigned the chancellorship nor was replaced by a Bundestag-elected Chancellor between 2026-09-17 and 2026-12-31.
